# EDK TRAINING

> > Professional strength training with StrongFirst-certified Coach Ericka specializing in Hardstyle kettlebell, barbell, and bodyweight coaching in Minneapolis and online.

EDK Training offers virtual and in-person strength coaching with expertise in StrongFirst methodologies, including SFG kettlebell certification prep, barbell training, and the StrongFirst Lifter program. Coach Ericka provides individual programming, group classes, and specialized workshops focused on functional movement and proper technique.

## Key Topics

- Hardstyle Kettlebell
- StrongFirst Certification
- Coach Ericka
- Turkish Get-Up
- Kettlebell Swing
- SFG Certification
- StrongFirst Lifter (SFL)
- Certification Prep
- Virtual Classes
- Personal Coaching
- Functional Fitness
- Corrective Exercise
- Mobility & Stability
- Minneapolis Training
- Remote Fitness

## Training Programs

- [Kettlebell Training](https://edktraining.com/kettlebell): Virtual & in-person kettlebell classes with Hardstyle instruction
- [Online Training Programs](https://edktraining.com/online-training): Online coaching for kettlebell, barbell & bodyweight training goals
- [Personal Training](https://edktraining.com/personal-training): In-person strength coaching in Minneapolis with StrongFirst prep
- [Barbell Coaching](https://edktraining.com/barbell): Barbell strength coaching & StrongFirst Lifter certification prep
- [Workshops](https://edktraining.com/workshops): Virtual workshops for mobility, breathwork, Turkish Get-Up & swing skills
- [Bells & Beers](https://edktraining.com/bells-beers): Kettlebell classes at Minneapolis craft breweries like Bauhaus
